text:
Elena: Quick sync — planning to enable the geo-failover feature flag for EU canary (10%) tonight at 02:00 UTC. This will route EU requests to eu models first and fall back to global if capacity is constrained. Need oncall + eng-sre thumbs up.
Sam: Can you paste the exact flag config and the rollback command? also what's the stickiness TTL?
Elena: Config below. Stickiness = 24h by default, per-route override possible. Rollback = ff toggle geo_failover false or set canary_pct 0.
```json
{ "geo_failover": { "enabled": true, "canary_pct": 10, "regions": ["eu-west-1"], "sticky_sessions": { "enabled": true, "ttl_hours": 24 }, "fallback_model_policy": "nearest-capacity->smaller-quantized" } }
```
Tia: I can be oncall for the window. I'll watch p95 latency and error rate. My thresholds: p95 > 350ms OR 5xx rate > 1% -> immediate rollback. Also looking at 5m CPU/GPU saturation on the eu pool.
Mike: Add a circuit-breaker threshold in the routing policy so we don't cascade. Suggest: if eu pool CPU > 82% for 3m OR queue depth > 200, force-canary-off. I'll add that to the runtime policy.
Sam: For observability, pls wire these dashboards: redwood.console -> routes/geo_failover -> p95, 5xx_rate, queue_depth, cost_delta. Set alerts to paging for Tia and notify #eng-oncall.
Elena: Good. Canary audience = 10% of EU traffic, random by user-id hash. We should exclude internal traffic (staging/test users) and any enterprise VIP routes. Also exclude requests with header x-internal: true.
Mike: I pushed the runtime guardrail PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/412 — includes CPU/queue circuit-breaker and a metric hook. Can someone review quickly?
Sam: I'll take it, quick pass in 15m.
Tia: One more request — in case of rollback we need a one-button ops-runbook to: disable flag -> flush sticky assignments -> revert routing weights. ops-bot, can you attach the runbook snippet here?
ops-bot: Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback steps
1) ff toggle geo_failover false
2) curl -X POST https://admin.internal/assignments/flush -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
3) terraform apply -var 'routing_weights_default=1.0' -auto-approve
4) notify #eng-platform + #eng-oncall
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled feature-flag change: geo_failover canary_pct=10 at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z by Elena (id: elena). Will emit deploy events to #deploys.
Elena: Final checklist before 02:00 UTC: (1) Tia oncall ✅ (2) PR review ✅ (Sam) (3) Dashboards/alerts wired ✅ (Sam) (4) Ops runbook posted ✅ (ops-bot) (5) Notify sales/support: I'll ping product to post customer note for VIPs who opted into low-latency routing.
Sam: Quick QA note — test plan: synthetic traffic from eu-west-1 with 1k rps for 10m, spike to 3k rps for 3m. Run the test 1 hour before the rollout.
Mike: I'll gate the canary with a pre-rollout smoke check. If smoke fails, auto-abort and set canary_pct=0.
Elena: Perfect. I'll proceed with the scheduled time. If anything changes I'll update this thread. :thumbsup:
